extracted text: The study focuses on Al-12Si piston alloy reinforced with in situ TiB2 particles. Both the composite and Al-12Si matrix alloy were solution treated at 470°C for 4h, water quenched and artificially aged at 235°C for 5.5h to achieve the T6 condition. The reinforced composite contains 4 wt% (2.4 vol%) TiB2 particles with size range of 50-400 nm. The mechanical properties were tested at three temperatures: 25°C (room temperature), 200°C (typical gudgeon pin boss temperature) and 350°C (typical combustion chamber bowl edge temperature).
property mapping:
YS = Yield strength in MPa
UTS = Ultimate tensile strength in MPa
Elongation = Elongation percentage
E = Young's modulus in GPa
abbreviations:
TiB2 = Titanium diboride
MMCs = Metal matrix composites
PRAMCs = Particle reinforced aluminum matrix composites
weight percentage: The Al-12Si matrix alloy contains: 12.37% Si, 4.13% Cu, 2.67% Ni, 0.82% Mg, 0.42% Fe, 0.20% Mn, 0.106% Ti, 0.006% Zn, and balance Al. The composite material contains 4 wt% TiB2 particles added to this matrix alloy.
